articles.summary: MOUNT PLEASANT, MI / ACCESS Newswire / November 19, 2026 / Isabella Bank Corporation (Nasdaq:ISBA) today announced its Board of Directors declared a fourth-quarter cash dividend of $0.29 per common share, representing a 3.6% increase to the most recent dividend declaration. The dividend is payable December 18, 2026 to shareholders of record as of December 16, 2026. About Isabella Bank Corporation Isabella Bank Corporation (Nasdaq: ISBA) is the parent holding company of Isabella Bank, a state-chartered community bank headquartered in Mt. Pleasant, Michigan. Isabella Bank was chartered in 1903 and has been committed to serving its customers' and communities' local banking needs for over 120 years. The Bank offers personal and commercial lending and deposit products, as well as investment, trust, and estate planning services through Isabella Wealth. The Bank has 33 locations throughout nine Michigan counties: Bay, Clare, Gratiot, Isabella, Kent, Mecosta, Midland, Montcalm, and Saginaw.
articles.title: Isabella Bank Corporation Announces Increase to Quarterly Dividend

articles.summary: MOUNT PLEASANT, MI / ACCESS Newswire / November 2, 2026 / Isabella Bank Corporation (the "Company" or "Isabella") (NASDAQ:ISBA), the parent company of Isabella Bank, announced today the completion of the previously announced acquisition of Grand River Commerce, Inc., the parent company of Grand River Bank (collectively "Grand River"), effective November 2, 2026. The combined company has approximately $2.7 billion in total assets, $2.0 billion in loans, and $2.3 billion in total deposits (based on financial information as of June 30, 2026). This strategic acquisition extends Isabella Bank's footprint into Kent County and the vibrant Grand Rapids market, including bringing Isabella Wealth Services to these new markets.
